name: Finishing a Development Branch
description: Use when implementation is complete and all tests pass — guides completion by presenting structured options for merge, PR, or cleanup.

promptPatterns: \b(finish(ing)? (a )?(development )?branch|merge (my )?branch|完成.*分支|分支收尾|ready to merge)\b

commands.injectPrompt: Apply the finishing-a-development-branch skill: verify the work is truly complete (tests green, no stray changes), then present structured integration options — merge, pull request, or cleanup — and execute the user's choice.
